Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) workflow using immunoprecipitation of DNMT3a/b followed by SDS-PAGE, silver staining, and in-gel digestion. Acquisition is DDA based on the use of a Q Exactive for gel-band analysis. While the discussion mentions potential glycosylation of RBM14, the MS analysis described was used for protein identification of the bands, not for PTM mapping or enrichment of glycopeptides.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment (LC-MS/MS) specifically compares the DNMT3b-interactome between two different human intestinal epithelial cell lines (HCT116 and SW480) characterized by their TLR4 methylation status. While the broader study involves siRNA and germ-free mice, the MS data (PXD035777) is derived from the comparison of these two cell lines.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment uses DDA (Q Exactive) and identifies proteins from silver-stained gel bands (in-gel digestion) comparing two cell lines (HCT116 vs SW480). While no formal label-free quantification software is mentioned, the comparison of band intensity and protein presence between two conditions is a standard LFQ-style setup.
